decisions.reason: After several years without visible continuation and as a single design variant close to the core range, it likely fell short of aspiration levels and is not worth the portfolio complexity.

Even though a product family can support range breadth, the absence of later market visibility suggests insufficient performance versus internal and peer aspirations to justify keeping several models.

As a flagship electronic access system aligned with the firm's digital direction and supported by proprietary capabilities, it would usually be retained or evolved unless there is clear sustained underperformance.
